description:
Returns a paginated list of the input items that were part of the
conversation context for the given response.

parameters.description: The response id returned by a previous create response request.
parameters.name: response_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100, default 20).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Default asc.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination. Returns items after this item ID.
parameters.name: after

404.description: Not found. No responses could be found with the given response_id.

summary: List input items for a previously generated response.

ListInputItemsResponse.description: A paginated list of input items for a stored response.

first_id.description: The ID of the first item in the list.

has_more.description: Whether there are more items beyond this page.

last_id.description: The ID of the last item in the list.

id.description: Stable identifier for this item within the response.

InputItemEntry.description: A single entry in the input items list, wrapping a `ModelInputPart` with an ID.

oneOf.description: Message input to the model.

name.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help xAI to monitor and detect abuse. Only supported for `user` messages.

role.description: The role of the message. Possible values are `user`, `assistant`, `system` and `developer`.

type.description: The type of the message, which is always `message`.

oneOf.description: The model output from previous responses.
The output of a function call.
The output of a shell call.
A compaction item from a previous `/v1/responses/compact` call.
Text input.
A list of input items to the model. Can include text and images.

FunctionToolCallOutput.description: The output of a function tool call.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the function tool call generated by the model.

output.description:
The output of the function tool call. Can be a plain string or a list
of content items (`input_text`, `input_image`, `input_file`).

type.description: The type of the function tool call, which is always `function_call_output`.

ShellCallOutput.description: The output of a shell tool call, sent by the client after local execution.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the shell tool call generated by the model.

max_output_length.description:
The maximum length of the shell command output. Generated by the model
and should be passed back with the raw output.

output.description: An array of shell call output contents.

type.description: The type of the output item, which is always `shell_call_output`.

CompactionOutputItem.description:
A compaction item from a previous `/v1/responses/compact` call.

Accepted as input in `/v1/responses` calls. Clients must treat
`encrypted_content` as opaque — do not parse or depend on its
internal structure.

encrypted_content.description: The encrypted content of the compacted conversation.

id.description: The unique ID of the compaction item (e.g. `cmp_<uuid>`).

type.description: The type of the item. Always `"compaction"`.

oneOf.description: Text input.
Text output (used in compact response output items).
Image input. Note: Storing and fetching images is not fully supported at the moment.

image_url.description: A public URL of image prompt, only available for vision models.

oneOf.description: File input.

file_data.description:
Inline file bytes (base64 encoded).

When set, the file content is provided directly in the request and does NOT need
to be uploaded to the Files API first.

Exactly one of `file_id`, `file_data`, or `file_url` should be set.

file_id.description:
The file ID from the Files API.

Set this to reference a previously-uploaded file.
Exactly one of `file_id`, `file_data`, or `file_url` should be set.

file_url.description:
Public URL for a file attachment.

When set, the file content is fetched from this URL.
Exactly one of `file_id`, `file_data`, or `file_url` should be set.

filename.description:
Filename for inline uploads.

Required when `file_data` is set.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type for inline uploads (e.g. "application/pdf").

OutputMessage.description: An output message from the model.

id.description: The unique ID of the output message.

role.description: The role of the output message, which can be `assistant` or `tool`.

status.description: Status of the item. One of `completed`, `in_progress` or `incomplete`.

type.description: The type of the output message, which is always `message`.

FunctionToolCall.description: A tool call to run a function.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the function, as a JSON string.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the function tool call generated by the model.

id.description: The unique ID of the function tool call.

status.description: Status of the item. One of `completed`, `in_progress` or `incomplete`.

type.description:
The type of the function tool call, which can be `"function_call"` for client-side tool calls,
and `"web_search_call"` or `"x_search_call"` or `"code_interpreter_call"` or `"mcp_call"` for server-side tool calls.

Reasoning.description: The reasoning done by the model.

encrypted_content.description: The enrypted reasoning. Returned when `reasoning.encrypted_content` is passed in `include`.

id.description: The unique ID of the reasoning content.

status.description: Status of the item. One of `completed`, `in_progress` or `incomplete`.

type.description: The type of the object, which is always `reasoning`.

WebSearchCall.description: The output of a web search tool call.

action.description:
An object describing the specific action taken in this web search call.
Includes details on how the model used the web (search, open_page, find).

id.description: The unique ID of the web search tool call.

status.description: The status of the web search tool call.

type.description: The type of the web search tool call. Always `web_search_call`.

FileSearchCall.description: The output of a web search tool call.

id.description: The unique ID of the file search tool call.

queries.description: The queries used to search for files.

results.description: The results of the file search tool call.

status.description: The status of the file search tool call.

type.description: The type of the file search tool call. Always `file_search_call`.

CodeInterpreterCall.description: The output of a code interpreter tool call.

code.description: The code of the code interpreter tool call.

id.description: The unique ID of the code interpreter tool call.

outputs.description: The outputs of the code interpreter tool call.

status.description: The status of the code interpreter tool call.

type.description: The type of the code interpreter tool call. Always `code_interpreter_call`.

McpCall.description: The output of a MCP tool call.

arguments.description: A JSON string of the arguments passed to the tool.

error.description: The error message of the MCP tool call.

id.description: The unique ID of the MCP tool call.

name.description: The name of the tool that was run.

output.description: The output of the MCP tool call.

server_label.description: The label of the MCP server running the tool.

status.description: The status of the MCP tool call.

type.description: The type of the MCP tool call. Always `mcp_call`.

CustomToolCall.description: The output of a custom tool call.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the function tool call generated by the model.

id.description: The status of the custom tool call.

input.description: The unique ID of the custom tool call,

name.description: An identifier used to map this custom tool call to a tool call output.

status.description: Status of the item. One of `completed`, `in_progress` or `incomplete`.

type.description: The input for the custom tool call generated by the model.

ShellCall.description: A shell command call emitted by the model for local execution.

action.description: The shell commands and limits that describe how to run the tool call.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the shell tool call generated by the model.

oneOf.description: The environment for the shell tool call.

id.description: The unique ID of the shell call item.

status.description: Status of the item. One of `completed`, `in_progress` or `incomplete`.

type.description: The type of the output item, which is always `shell_call`.

ImageGenerationCall.description: The output of an image generation tool call.

id.description: The unique ID of the image generation tool call.

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate the image.

result.description:
The generated image encoded in base64 (OpenAI-compatible: bare
base64, no data-URL prefix), or `null` while the call is still in
progress or has failed. The image format can be determined from the
decoded magic bytes (typically JPEG or PNG).

status.description:
The status of the image generation tool call. One of `in_progress`,
`generating`, `completed` or `failed`.

type.description: The type of the image generation tool call. Always `image_generation_call`.

oneOf.description:
Type tag for [`ImageGenerationCall`]. Serializes as
`"image_generation_call"`.

A single-variant enum rather than a `String`: `ImageGenerationCall` lives
in the untagged `ModelOutput` / `ModelInputPart` enums and every other
field is defaulted or optional, so with a plain `String` type field the
struct would match *any* JSON object carrying a `type` key — swallowing
`function_call_output` (and similar) input items before their own
variants are tried.

ToolSearchCall.description: A server-side tool search call made by the model.

arguments.description: The arguments of the tool search call: `{"query": ..., "limit": ...}`.

id.description: The unique ID of the tool search call item.

status.description:
Status of the item. One of `in_progress`, `completed` or
`incomplete` (a failed search).

type.description: The type of the item. Always `tool_search_call`.

oneOf.description:
Type tag for [`ToolSearchCall`]; a single-variant enum (not a `String`)
for the same untagged-enum disambiguation as [`ImageGenerationCallType`].

ToolSearchOutput.description: The tool definitions loaded by a completed tool search call.

id.description: The unique ID of the tool search output item.

tools.description: The loaded tool definitions, echoed in the shape they were supplied in.

type.description: The type of the item. Always `tool_search_output`.

oneOf.description:
Type tag for [`ToolSearchOutput`]. Serializes as `"tool_search_output"`.
See [`ToolSearchCallType`] for why this is a single-variant enum.

ShellCallOutputResult.description: The content of a shell tool call output that was emitted.

outcome.description: The outcome of the command execution.

stderr.description: The standard error output that was captured.

stdout.description: The standard output that was captured.

oneOf.description: Text output.

logprobs.description: The log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

text.description: The text output from the model.

oneOf.description: Refusal.

type.description: The type of the object, which is always `reasoning_text`.

text.description: Summary of the reasoning done by the model.

type.description: The type of the object, which is always `summary_text`.

oneOf.description: Action type "search" - Performs a web search query.

sources.description: The sources used in the search.

oneOf.description: Action type "open_page" - Opens a specific URL from search results.

url.description: The URL of the page to open.

oneOf.description:
Action type "find_in_page": Searches for a pattern within a loaded
page. Wire shape mirrors OpenAI's `ActionFind` so the OpenAI Python
SDK's typed `web_search_call.action` parses correctly — note the
`find_in_page` tag (not `find`) and the flat `url` (not nested
under a `source` field).

pattern.description: The pattern or text to search for within the page.

url.description: The URL of the page being searched within.

file_id.description: The file ID of the file search result.

filename.description: The filename of the file search result.

score.description:
The score of the file search result.
Proto3 omits float fields with value 0.0; default to 0.0 when absent.

text.description: The text of the file search result.

oneOf.description: The output of the code interpreter tool call.

logs.description: The output of the code interpreter tool call.

oneOf.description: The error of the code interpreter tool call.

url.description: The error of the code interpreter tool call.

ShellCallAction.description: The shell commands and limits that describe how to run the tool call.

max_output_length.description: Optional maximum number of characters to return from each command.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the commands.

type.description: The type of the action, which is always `exec`.

ShellEnvironment.description: The environment configuration for a shell tool.

skills.description: An optional list of skills available in the local environment.

type.description: The type of the environment. Currently only `local` is supported.

ShellCallOutcome.description: The outcome of a shell command execution.

oneOf.description: The command exited normally.

exit_code.description: The exit code of the command.

oneOf.description: The command timed out.

end_index.description: The end index of the annotation.

type.description: The type of the annotation. Only supported type currently is `url_citation`.

url.description: The URL of the web resource.

bytes.description: The ASCII encoding of the output character.

logprob.description: The log probability of returning this token.

top_logprobs.description: An array of the most likely tokens to return at this token position.

type.description: The type of source.

LocalShellSkill.description: A skill available in the local shell environment.

description.description: A description of what the skill does.

path.description: The path to the directory containing the skill (with a SKILL.md file).

bytes.description: The ASCII encoding of the output character.

logprob.description: The log probability of returning this token.
